title: POLYGON COLLOSUS TLE
description:
We are thrilled to introduce the latest addition to our lineup, the Collosus TLE. This project was born out of a desire to push the boundaries of what our Collosus range could offer to riders like you. Let's delve into the journey that led to the creation of this exceptional bike.​

The Collosus range has long been known for providing a capable platform at an accessible price point. With the TLE, we sought to elevate this experience by revisiting carbon and integrating our innovative IFS (Internal Floating Suspension) system, inspired by the success of our Collosus N and Collosus DH models. Our goal was to make this advanced suspension system lighter and more affordable without compromising on stiffness or performance.​

Over the years, we have honed our craft and listened to the needs of riders, leading us to develop the Collosus TLE as a reflection of the progression and journey our riders are on. This bike, it's a companion that offers a custom-tuned riding experience, tailored to enhance your time on the trails.​

The design goals of the Collosus TLE were clear from the outset. By reimagining the IFS system within the Collosus platform, we were able to refine the bike's kinematics, leveraging years of expertise to achieve the ideal balance of anti-squat, anti-rise, and leverage curve. This meticulous approach ensures optimal climbing efficiency, braking performance, and overall suspension sensitivity for a truly dynamic riding experience.​

With a full 29er configuration, the Collosus TLE boasts a host of features aimed at maximizing performance and customization. From the Fox-tuned shocks to the versatile shock yoke design, every detail has been carefully engineered to offer tunability in every direction, empowering riders to tailor their ride to their exact preferences.​

Additionally, practical elements such as tailgate protection, ample chainstay coverage, and internal cable routing enhance both the aesthetics and functionality of the bike, ensuring a smooth and quiet ride on any terrain. With compatibility for Bosch motors, a range extender option, and stock inclusion of a Bosch power more 250wh battery, the Collosus TLE is ready to take on any adventure you have in store.​

In conclusion, the Collosus TLE represents a new chapter in our commitment to delivering high-performance bikes that meet the evolving needs of riders at every skill level. We invite you to experience the thrill of the ride with the Collosus TLE and join us on this exciting journey into the world of full-suspension carbon bikes.​
